$comment: Bundle budget for the static export, checked by scripts/perf-budget.mjs (QRun-IO/qqq#710). Sizes are KB gzip. '_' is the exported placeholder of a dynamic segment: /app/_ is /app/[slug] (app home, record query, process, report), /app/_/_ is the record view. The 2026-09-26 merge of ESB process management (#13) into Next UI 1.0 moved measured total JS from 706.6 to 736.2 KB and /app/_ first-load JS from 461.7 to 470.2 KB; the 750 and 475 KB caps retain narrow headroom for that combined product. Linux CI measured /app/_/_ at 455.7 KB, 0.7 KB above its previous cap; 460 KB leaves about 1% headroom. Raise a cap only with the reason in the commit.
